## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Mixed-case writes should be fixed because the new setter violates the cache’s case-insensitive lookup contract.

## Changes
The pull request adds `Cache.set`, raises the default TTL to 300 seconds, and adds round-trip and expiry tests. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cache.py:27 — correctness — Normalize keys before storing cache entries — Calling `set("ALPHA", 1)` followed by `get("ALPHA")` returns `None`: the setter stores the original key, but the getter looks up `key.lower()`. — Mixed-case writes become inaccessible, and mixed-case updates to existing lowercase keys leave callers reading the old value. — Fix: Store under `key.lower()` and extend `test_set_then_get_round_trip` with mixed-case writes.
